name: integration-pattern-selection
description: Select integration pattern between services: synchronous (request-response, RPC), asynchronous (message queue, pub/sub, event streaming), saga (orchestration vs choreography), CQRS boundary, transactional outbox, change-data-capture (CDC), polling, webhook callback. Per pattern: when-to-use / trade-offs / failure modes / idempotency + retry semantics. Produces recommendation with consistency + coupling + observability trade-offs. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
